customInstructions: AGENTS.md is the canonical source of truth when present. Use Plan Mode for analysis and Act Mode for approved edits. Before non-trivial work, run `npm run doctor` to verify MCP, extension, shell, Doppler, Node, and gate paths. Start local development only with `doppler run -- npm run dev`. Before claiming completion or PR readiness, run the canonical gate helper: `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .agents/skills/mgpl-gate-runner/scripts/run-gates.ps1`. The gate helper runs doctor, TypeScript, client syntax, spelling, unit tests, Playwright with exactly one worker, and `gates/run-all.sh` via explicitly resolved Git Bash. Do not run bare `bash gates/run-all.sh`, do not run bare `npm run dev`, do not add Prisma, and do not deploy, merge to main, or perform production writes.
